test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains, 140 m and 120 m in length, are running in the same direction at the speed of 60 km/h and 78 km/h, respectively. In how much time will they completely cross each other?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 140 m

Length of Train 2 = 120 m

Speed of Train 1 = 60 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 78 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of Train 2 - Speed of Train 1

Time = (Sum of Lengths of Trains) / Relative Speed
